body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency has not established a standard for building and physical premises safety, including the identification of and protection from hazards, bodies of water and vehicular traffic for license-exempt in-home providers, and identification of and protection from vehicular traffic for license-exempt family child care providers, as required by 98.41(a)(1)(v). (Plan Questions 5.3.5avi, 5.3.5bvi, 5.3.5cvi, and 5.3.5cv) • The Lead Agency does not require pre-service or orientation training on building and physical premises safety, including identification of and protection from hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic for license-exempt in-home providers, as required by 98.44(b)(1)(i). (Plan Question 5.4.1e) • The Lead Agency does not require an annual inspection for license-exempt family child care providers for compliance with a standard for the identification of and protection from vehicular traffic, as required by 98.42(b)(2)(ii).
